correctness.rationale: Construct the normalized right/left stationary state from two drift-diffusion equations and the exact wall-current balance. Integrate the cosh mixture to obtain V=1/12+((beta-1+exp(-p))/(p+beta-1+exp(-p)))B with B in (0,1/6). The sign yields the global feasibility dichotomy. A comparison scale p=H+log H and a global upper bound pin every maximizer to p/H→1; exact interior log derivative yields the coefficient seven, uniform over maximizers. A second substitution gives the stated gain expansion. Standalone standard-library checker passed 653 supplemental assertions; it does not establish the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: At fixed dimensionless active-to-thermal ratio beta=v²/(D alpha), varying interval length changes Peclet and measures normalized confinement independently of geometric units. The sharp beta=1 feasibility boundary and critical log–log growth of the optimal interval Peclet provide a qualitative threshold; the explicit vanishing gain and nonregular next order describe the cost of confinement near that threshold. This is a motivated singular global optimization, not merely a fixed-parameter moment evaluation. It does not claim external thermodynamic or experimental validation.
